notes: «عنه» at the start is the back reference (rule: Previous reports). prev1 to prev6 pass it on without writing a chain; prev7 is the nearest that writes one, and its first name (Kulayni) is taken over. This reading is a judgement on which name «عنه» refers to; the tool holds the final check.

«قال بعث إلينا أبوالحسن موسى عليه السلام» has the Imam speak inside the Makhzumi's account: the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 5). «وكانت أمه من ولد جعفر بن أبي طالب» is a dashed gloss: left out.
